verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation and company-management product with a dashboard, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence covers only incorporation, equity, 83(b) filings, SAFEs, banking and documents, with no mention of any AI insights or suggestions feature. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes make documentation readable by LLMs, which is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for in-product AI insights.
